name: Orders Incremental Upsert (OLTP -> Mart)
description: Synchronizes changed order rows every 5 minutes using watermark-guarded ON CONFLICT upsert and Target Receipt v1.
transformConfig: {"version":1,"sourceQuery":"SELECT order_id, customer_code, total_amount, status_code, updated_at FROM public.orders WHERE updated_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '2 hours'","targetTable":"mart.fact_orders","mode":"upsert","reconciliationStrategy":"target-receipt-v1","keyColumns":["order_id"],"watermarkColumn":"updated_at"}
